Android APKMannequin Playground

A 3D playground with the mannequin from this repository, animated with the bundled walk / run / jump clips and driven by on-screen touch controls.

Download the APK MannequinPlayground.apk · version 1.0 · 0.85 MB · Android 5.0+

Install

  1. Tap Download the APK above (do this on the phone, not on a computer).
  2. Open the downloaded file from your notifications or the Files app.
  3. Android asks you to allow installing unknown apps for the browser or Files app — allow it, then tap Install. The APK is self-signed with a throw-away certificate (like a debug build), so Play Protect may offer to scan it first.
  4. Launch Mannequin Playground. It is landscape, so hold the phone sideways.

Controls

JoystickWalk — push to the edge to run (or use the RUN button)
JUMPJump; hold for a slightly higher hop
Drag the worldLook around
⚙ gearJoystick / jump-button size, opacity and placement, plus quality, sound and haptics

Tap Move controls in the settings panel, then drag the joystick and the jump button wherever your thumbs rest — the layout is saved. Everything else (quality preset, day/night, shadows, run style, handedness) is in the same panel.

What is inside

  • 8-ring course around the park with a timer and a best-run record.
  • Playground balls you can grab and throw, seesaw, carousel, slides, trees and benches.
  • No network access at runtime — the page, the mannequin and all three motion clips are embedded in the APK.
